## Introduction

This project analyzes biometric data collected from students.

## Data Loading

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load the data
students_data <- read.csv("data/students_data.csv")
students_weight <- read.csv("data/students_weight.csv")

# Display first few rows
head(students_data)
head(students_weight)
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
# Summary statistics
summary(students_data)
summary(students_weight)
```

## Conclusion

Analysis complete!
